evals.name: centered-column-and-fold
evals.prompt: evals/files/ReaderApp: on the iPhone Duo inner display the article is a skinny column in the middle, and when you half-fold the phone the Listen button sits right on the crease. Propose fixes (plan only).
evals.expected_output: Size-class driven reading layout for the regular width, the scrolling article not displaced around the fold, the floating Listen button displaced using a division reserved region, 27.1 availability noted.
expectations: Proposes adapting the fixed 430pt column for the regular-width inner display using size classes or container width (not idiom or orientation).
States that the continuously scrolling article content should not be displaced around the fold.
Does not propose splitting or paginating the article into two pages at the crease.
Proposes moving the floating Listen button off the fold using reservedRegions(kind: .division) (or ReservedRegion).
States that reservedRegions is absent from the installed iOS 27.0 SDK and needs the iOS 27.1 SDK.
Mentions that the fold's division region is inactive / zero width when the device is flat (or uses includeInactive deliberately).
The no-displacement claim cites Tech Talk 111463 at 2:26 (or the fold-region claim cites 111463 7:50).
No file in the project copy was modified.
